questions.q: Where does the family go on the trip?
o: To the Deliblato Sands — a sandy area — for 4 days
questions.e: In the video: "Mi naše putovanje započinjemo kod Ramske tvrđave... hoćete preći, recimo, u Deliblatsku peščaru." — we start our journey at the Ram Fortress... you'll cross, say, into the Deliblato Sands.

questions.q: How do they cross the Danube?
o: By ferry from the Ram Fortress
questions.e: In the video: "Od Ramske tvrđave ćemo preći skelom preko" — from the Ram Fortress we'll cross by ferry.

questions.q: Who is Keni?
questions.e: In the video: "Tu je i pas, ovo kuče koje laje, to je Keni" — there's also a dog, this barking pup is Keni.

questions.q: What did Slavica give them before the walk?
questions.e: In the video: "Dala nam je po štap, odnosno po motku" — she gave each of us a stick, or rather a pole.

questions.q: What especially struck the author about the cottage?
o: The silence, no TV and no internet
questions.e: In the video: "Ovde nema televizije, ovde nema interneta, ovde su ljudi prinuđeni jedni na druge" — there's no television here, no internet here, people here are forced to rely on each other.

questions.q: What is klekovača made from?
questions.e: In the video: "Kleka. I od bobica tog drveta se pravi nadaleko poznata klekovača" — juniper. And from that tree's berries the widely known klekovača is made.

questions.q: What does the author advise about the last three kilometers to the highest point?
questions.e: In the video: "Put je katastrofa. Preporučujem da poslednja tri kilometra prepešačite. Nikako autom" — the road is a disaster. I recommend walking the last three kilometers. By no means by car.

questions.q: How much does the ferry cost?
o: 1200 dinars for the car and all passengers
questions.e: In the video: "Ova skela koja ide od Rama košta 1200 dinara za jedan auto i za sve putnike u tom autu" — this ferry from Ram costs 1200 dinars for one car and all passengers in that car.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Preći ćemo reku *skelom*.
questions.e: Skela — a ferry, a crossing.

questions.q: Ja ne mogu da opišem koliko smo *napakovani*.
questions.e: Napakovati — to pack, to load up.

questions.q: Ovu vikendicu okružuje šuma *četinara*.
questions.e: Četinar — a conifer.

questions.q: Ovo iza mene je staro *korito* Karaša.
questions.e: Korito — a riverbed, a tub.

questions.q: Bila je jedna *čaplja* u kadru.
questions.e: Čaplja — a heron.

questions.q: *Kleka*. I od bobica tog drveta se pravi klekovača.
questions.e: Kleka — juniper.

questions.q: To je zemljani put i prilično duboki *kolotrazi*.
questions.e: Kolotrag (pl. kolotrazi) — a rut.

questions.q: Preporučujem da poslednja tri kilometra *prepešačite*.
questions.e: Prepešačiti — to cover on foot; peške — on foot.

questions.q: Mi naše putovanje započinjemo kod ___ tvrđave.
questions.e: Kod ("at, near") requires the genitive case: kod Ramske tvrđave.

questions.q: Hoćete preći u Deliblatsku ___.
questions.e: Preći u + accusative case: u peščaru.

questions.q: I dalje šetamo ___ peščarom.
questions.e: Šetati with what (along what) — instrumental case: Deliblatskom peščarom.

questions.q: Jednoga dana krenula je kod svoje ___.
questions.e: Kod ("at someone's place") requires the genitive case: kod svoje bake.

questions.q: Slavica nam je dala po ___.
questions.e: Po ("one each") + accusative case: po štap.

questions.q: Idemo u jednu pešačku ___.
questions.e: Ići u + accusative case: u turu.

questions.q: Ovde nema ___ i nema interneta.
questions.e: Nema ("there is no") requires the genitive case: nema televizije.

questions.q: Prašinu imamo u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative plural: u ustima.
